layout: 5 battery columns x 8 rows for duos. Engine and industrial use separate 5x4 service atlases; their final prompts follow. Rank 0 uses original sheets.

finalServiceAtlases.engine-claude: Create ONE NEW transparent game sprite atlas, use input only as character identity reference. EXACTLY FIVE equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows. 20 FULL-BODY CHARACTERS total on a perfectly regular 5x4 grid, canvas aspect ratio 5:4 with SQUARE cells. Four rows, not three. No text, no titles, no labels, no scenery, no grid lines. Every creature centered with 8% transparent padding, NEVER overlap any neighboring cell. Every ROW is a separate dramatic evolution stage: friend, close, best friend, soulmate in that order. Every COLUMN is a battery expression state left-to-right: 1 very energetic open-eyed joyful upright pose; 2 calm normal neutral open eyes; 3 very tired slouched drooping half-open eyelids; 4 exhausted dizzy SPIRAL eyes and sagging posture; 5 zero battery ASLEEP with closed eyes and curled/resting posture. Render EVERY state in EVERY row, keep same stage outfit/wing/limb design across its five columns. Emphasize unmistakable silhouette and whole-body transformation as stages progress, not badge overlays. Beautiful detailed rendering, large legible expressive face. Adult brunette astronaut woman, same young adult face and wavy brown hair in every row, never a child. Premium polished 3D cinematic space art, white amber gold with blue reactor accents. Row1 upgraded slim explorer flight suit and helmet. Row2 star commander with luxurious long hair and massive articulated twin jetpack, flowing blue cape. Row3 heroic star knight with huge white-gold mechanical wings and ornate exosuit. Row4 cosmic astronaut empress with enormous solar wings, elaborate blue/gold galaxy suit and floating planet rings. Each successive whole-body design dramatically transforms. Sleeping rows close eyes and rest head on hands or curled knees, keep all stage-specific wings and helmet.
